en: Paṭṭhānapakaraṇa:
Dhammapaccanīya (2), Tikadukapaṭṭhānapāḷi (4) 10.4.
Kusala-ttika, Cūḷantara-duka.
Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor conditioned by a cause … dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor unconditioned … (Abbreviated.
Under the root condition there are twenty-nine; under the object condition, twenty-four … under the resultant condition, nine … under the non-disappearance condition, twenty-nine.
Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor visible … (Abbreviated.)
In the case of the root condition, twenty-nine; in the object condition, twenty-four … pe … in the ripening condition, nine … pe … in the non-disappearance condition, twenty-nine.
Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor impinging … (Abbreviated.
In the case of the root condition, twenty-nine; in the object condition, twenty-four … pe … in the ripening condition, nine … pe … in the non-disappearance condition, twenty-nine.
Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor impinging … (Abbreviated.
Nine [answers] for root; … pe … nine for non-disappearance.
Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor non-material … (Abbreviated.)
In the case of the root condition, twenty-four; ... pe ... in the case of the resultant condition, nine; ... pe ... in the case of the non-disappearance condition, twenty-four.
Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor material ... (Abbreviated. In the case of the root condition, nine; ... pe ...
in the case of the non-disappearance condition, nine.
Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor mundane … (Abbreviated. With respect to root:
seventeen … pe … with respect to repetition: nine … pe … with respect to result: nine … pe … with respect to non-disappearance: seventeen.
Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor supramundane … (Abbreviated.)

In the case of root condition, twenty-nine; in the case of object condition, twenty-four … pe … in the case of resultant condition, nine … pe … in the case of non-disappearance condition, twenty-nine.
Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor cognizable by any [consciousness] … pe … dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor not cognizable by any [consciousness] … (Abbreviated.

In the case of root condition, twenty-nine; in the case of object condition, twenty-four … pe … in the case of resultant condition, nine … pe … in the case of non-disappearance condition, twenty-nine.
